description: Use this when the connected user asks what AIApply prepared for one specific application, identified by the job_id returned from list_applications or list_review_jobs. Read the cover letter AIApply wrote, unless it was withheld. This never submits, approves, edits, or withdraws anything, and it returns neither the resume file nor the form answers. Needs an AIApply account: if the user has not signed in, calling it asks them to sign in or create one.

job_id.description: The job_id from list_applications or list_review_jobs.

name: preview_application

answer_count.description: How many form answers AIApply prepared. The answers themselves stay in AIApply, since the questions are employer-written and carry no category metadata to tell a protected trait from an ordinary question.

cover_letter.description: Null when the application has no cover letter, and also when one was withheld; cover_letter_withheld tells the two apart.

cover_letter_withheld.description: True when a cover letter exists but was withheld for carrying contact details, credentials, health information or embedded instructions.

job.description: Null when no such application belongs to the account.

listing_url.description: Null when the link is not on the allowlist.

match_score.description: Null when the job has not been scored.

matched_at.description: When AIApply matched this job to the user, ISO 8601. Null when unknown.

title: Preview a prepared AIApply application
